sam_csm: Quick sync — QBR slides + enablement asks. Need exec alignment on renewal risk for AtlasPay. Can folks confirm owners for slides and action owners? TL;DR: 3 risk flags (billing delays, onboarding usage lag, SSO integration), and one pending enablement session. Pinged execs for a dry run Wed.
maria_cs: I'll own the onboarding slides + health metrics. Will pull activation funnel and churn signals. ETA EOD Tue.
jon_eng: I can add infra telemetry + latency SLA numbers. Need which time window? 30/60/90d?
sam_csm: 30d for latency, 90d for activation. thx
lee_pm: For exec asks we should prioritize renewal risk + 2 mitigations. Suggest: 1) Dedicated onboarding sweeps, 2) Temporary usage credits. Thoughts?
kim_csm: I can run a focused enablement session for the AtlasPay power users next Thurs. Will prepare a 30-min demo + FAQ. Need list of customers to invite.
maria_cs: I'll send the invite list from CRM. Also capture any open CS tickets -> I'll drop them into slide appendix.
sam_csm: Action owners so far: slides: maria(onboarding), jon(telemetry), lee(exec asks), kim(enablement). Can we add renewal owner? @julian_sales ?
ops_bot: Reminder — QBR deck template located at https://redwood.app/internal/qbr-template. Auto-checklist: slides, exec-asks, action owners, appendix. :white_check_mark:
lee_pm: I'll draft the exec-facing 2-slide risk summary and 1-page mitigation plan. Will post in thread when done.
jon_eng: attaching quick snippet I'll paste into infra slide:
```
P99 latency: 120ms (30d)
Errors: 0.02%
Throughput: 12k reqs/day
```
kim_csm: For enablement session, need marketing collateral + slides. @maria_cs can you share onboarding playbook?
maria_cs: Sharing playbook in #shared-drive — link: https://redwood.app/drive/atlaspay-onboarding
Also capturing two customer quotes for slides.
sam_csm: OK team — let's sync Fri 10am for dry run. If any blockers DM me. Last ask: capture any exec-level feedback in one bullet per owner in this thread. :eyes:
